reviews.title: 1 Star – Your Own Music Held Hostage Behind a Paywall
reviews.text:
I imported my own MP3 music files into this app and later deleted the original files from my iPhone, trusting that the imported copies would remain accessible in the player.

Now I want to get my music back into the iPhone Files app so I can use it elsewhere. Unfortunately, this app makes that unnecessarily difficult.

The Share feature requires a Premium subscription. The app doesn't expose its music folder through the Files app or Apple's file-sharing system. Even the Backup feature creates a proprietary .omp file that cannot be opened without a password, and the app never gives you the option to create one or explains how to access the contents.

These are MY music files. I supplied them. 

I should not have to pay a subscription just to retrieve and access music that I already owned before installing this app.

At the very least, provide users with a straightforward way to export their original MP3 files without requiring Premium. Users should have control over their own content.

Until that changes, I cannot recommend this app.

reviews.title: Poderia estar como estava
reviews.text:
App bom, mas resolveram restringir as únicas opções que me mantinham a usar o app. Já não basta ter muitas limitações no app por ser grátis, agora também fecharam a opção “mais tocadas” e “tocadas recentemente” obrigando o usurário a ter que assinar o premium por opções bastante simples e que de certa forma não muita em quase nada na navegação e desempenho do app. 
Carece de algumas correções, músicas adicionadas que desaparecem, músicas que tocam e sai com o som meio destorcido… enfim, o app estava suportável por ter as opções acima mencionadas, mas agora torna-se inevitável ter que procurar um app que abrigue e proporcione algumas das qualidades que um usuario e amante da música precisa

reviews.title: Ad spam
reviews.text: I can understand that apps want to earn revenue through advertising but this app is pure advertising spam to the point that it is utterly unusable. You get bombarded with ads which you cannot dismiss. Instead you have to wait until the "close" button appears whereupon you are just served with the next ad, not able to access the app at all. I downloaded the app, installed a few tracks, and watched ads ad nauseam without ever being able to try the app out at all. So I deleted it without having been able as much as to try the app out. Shameful, time wasting, as well as stupid.
